# Visa Doc Translate

Curated by Skill Harbor: a document-translation skill for visa paperwork. Give it an image (bank deposit, employment, income, retirement, or property certificate, business license, ID; HEIC, PNG, or JPG) and it runs an automatic pipeline: HEIC conversion, EXIF-based rotation, OCR via macOS Vision, EasyOCR, or Tesseract, professional English translation preserving structure, names, numbers, and dates, then a bilingual PDF pairing the original image with the formatted translation. Requires Python packages (pillow, reportlab, plus an OCR engine). By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: it runs fully on your machine, so your documents never leave it; but an AI translation is a draft, not a legally certified or sworn translation, and immigration authorities may require an officially certified translator. Verify every number, date, and amount yourself. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
